purpose: Sanitized executable contract for witnessed Tether failures and critical controls
baseline_semantics: A baseline_defect probe passes only when it reproduces the named defect. L1 must replace it with a desired-contract test before deleting the probe.

incidents.mechanism: An accepted native turn with no reply callback remains awaiting_ack without an age or driver-terminal transition and blocks later work.
incidents.desired_contract: Every admitted native turn reaches a typed terminal or operator-visible uncertain state through driver evidence, never model obedience.

incidents.mechanism: Generic thread egress can succeed while the exact native attempt remains open.
incidents.desired_contract: Generic egress cannot close an execution attempt. Driver evidence alone closes execution; any explicit progress post is a separate idempotent operation.

incidents.mechanism: Health counts awaiting_ack as blocked while unresolved only returns uncertain attempts.
incidents.desired_contract: Health, list, and resolve operate on the same blocker set and advertise only valid actions.

incidents.mechanism: Passing only a temporary intake path loses the payload when the writer disappears or cleans up.
incidents.desired_contract: Handoff accepts inline content or an owner-private content-addressed durable blob with explicit retention.

incidents.mechanism: Fleet wrapper calls reply without the now-required attempt reply key and suppresses the nonzero result.
incidents.desired_contract: One generated client owns the typed broker contract; required fields cannot drift across repositories.

incidents.mechanism: Fleet hook calls generic post without the required idempotency key and converts failure into success.
incidents.desired_contract: One generated client owns the typed broker contract and never hides a rejected write.

incidents.mechanism: Credential helper validation must fail before native traffic with a typed, correlated reason.
incidents.desired_contract: Capability and credential providers expose readiness before admission; failure never wedges an accepted turn.

incidents.mechanism: One endpoint may own many thread bindings while permitting only one active turn.
incidents.desired_contract: Endpoint is first-class; N bindings share one fair scheduler and one lease.

incidents.mechanism: Restart safely requeues only proven pre-I/O work and preserves ambiguous outcomes.
incidents.desired_contract: Every transition has a crash test and typed recovery action with no blind replay.

incidents.mechanism: Edit/delete routing keeps the exact workspace, thread, event, writer, and generation.
incidents.desired_contract: Normalized ingress mutation semantics remain deterministic under the public Hermes contract.

incidents.mechanism: Peer bots and workspace identity must never inherit authority from thread participation alone.
incidents.desired_contract: Slack principal and workspace are explicit inputs to one fail-closed admission decision.

incidents.mechanism: Remote acceptance before local commit remains uncertain until exact receipt reconciliation.
incidents.desired_contract: One Hermes-owned ledger covers every durable egress operation with rejected, failed-before-I/O, accepted, delivered, retryable, or uncertain receipts and exact reconciliation.

incidents.mechanism: Cancellation and files remain attempt/destination bound across ambiguous I/O.
incidents.desired_contract: Cancellation and file operations use the same typed lifecycle and canonical egress receipt boundary.
